infrastructure: Albania has improving urban internet connectivity, with fibre rollout accelerating in Tirana.
Mobile connectivity is widespread but fixed broadband in rural areas is very limited.
EU pre-accession investment is supporting digital infrastructure development.
talent: University of Tirana and Polytechnic University of Tirana have limited AI research capacity.
Significant Albanian diaspora in Italy, Greece, and other EU countries contains relevant tech talent.
Domestic tech talent pool is small and brain drain rates are high.
governance: Albania is an EU accession candidate, driving governance reform aligned with EU standards.
Data protection law is being aligned with GDPR; the Commissioner for the Right to Information and Personal Data Protection is the regulator.
Anti-corruption reforms are a central EU accession requirement, driving gradual improvement.
investment: EU pre-accession IPA funds support digital transformation and governance capacity.
Very limited foreign AI-specific investment; economy is dominated by remittances and tourism.
Some diaspora investment in the tech sector is beginning.
economic_readiness: A growing economy with tourism and remittances as primary drivers, with limited industrial AI demand.
Young population with growing mobile internet use creating a consumer AI adoption base.
Low GDP per capita limits enterprise AI spending.
